blocks.text: This page tracks the Port Moody MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,011,500 for a typical home, down 5.8% over twelve months.
Port Moody benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Port Moody home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,011,500 in September 2026. That is down 2.5% on the month, down 2.9% over three months, down 2.2% over six months and down 5.8% over the year. Over three years it is down 8.8%, and over five years little changed at +0.6%.
The weakest one-year move in Port Moody was for a detached home homes at −8.4%; the strongest was an apartment at −4.9%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,903,500) and an apartment ($676,200) is $1,227,300, and a townhouse ($940,900) sits $264,700 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Port Moody is 6.0% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 5.8% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Port Moody ranks 11 by all-home benchmark, with Richmond above it at $1,015,800 and Burnaby East below it at $982,400.

Detached homes in Port Moody: benchmark $1,903,500, down 3.0% in a month, down 2.3% in three months, down 3.7% in six months, down 8.4% in a year, down 7.8% in three years and up 3.5% in five. That is 6.7% above the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Port Moody: benchmark $940,900, down 4.7% in a month, down 5.3% in three months, down 2.1% in six months, down 5.2% in a year, down 9.0% in three years and up 5.9% in five. That is 7.5% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Port Moody: benchmark $676,200, little changed at −0.6% in a month, down 3.2% in three months, down 3.7% in six months, down 4.9% in a year, down 5.1% in three years and up 6.7% in five. That is 0.9% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the Port Moody figure is
The $1,011,500 Port Moody figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Port Moody home was $1,011,500, with detached at $1,903,500.

faq.q: Are Port Moody home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Port Moody is down 5.8% over twelve months and down 2.9% over three months.
